name: Furger Family Farm
description: Furger Family Farm is a working farm in 204 Lovering Road, WI. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
